notes.title: Update 1.1.2
notes.notes:
In the mission selection menu, 3 new test missions have been added that are in a state of development - Stalingrad, Operation Torch and Landing in Normandy.
Fixed a bug in which it was impossible to set the explosives.

notes.title: Update 1.1.1
Update 1.0.6
Update 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.5 changelog:
[list]
[*] - The interaction time with some items in the Halloween 1944 event has been reduced
[*] - Closed some places on the map of the Halloween 1944 event in which the player could get behind the map
[*] - Simplified system of firing from hand grenade launchers
[*] - Added RaketenWerfer rocket launcher for Halloween 1944 event
[*] - Added flamethrower mechanics
[*] - Improved AntiPumpkin Rifle parameters
[*] - In the Halloween 1944 event, fixed a bug where the death animation was not played when killing Pumpkinheads
[*] - In the Halloween 1944 event, the bug where after death Pumpkinheads could still cause damage to the player has been fixed
[*] - Added boss Kürbiskopfroboter in Halloween 1944 event
[*] - Stamina recovery speed increased by 2 times
[*] - Redesigned camera rotation system
[*] - Minefields have been added around the play area in the Bir-Hakeim mission
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Changelog version 1.0.2
[list]
[*] Increased player stamina
[*] Fixed a problem in the mission "Anthropoid" due to which the officers calling for reinforcements did not come to the place of hostilities
[*] Changed the system of mission indicators - now it's easier to navigate on the map. Each additional task has its own number, which is highlighted on the indicator.
[*] Radar in the lower right corner removed
[*] Added mini-map in the lower right corner
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38793302/6667bdd97614a650dee17b9c924c43e7083d888a.png[/img]
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Changelog version 1.0.1
[list]
[*] In the mission "First Strike" the ability to go outside the map was removed
[*] Fixed a bug due to which 7TP tanks in the mission "First Hit" did not use the main weapon
[*] Changes have been made to the starting area of ​​the "First Hit" mission
[img]https://sun9-67.userapi.com/NIgud-z0M5XR30BMC5TsF1k_2t4Tgul1N9Ik_g/uOXC0TdORPc.jpg[/img]
[*] Gameplay changes have been made to the Village location in the "First Hit" mission
[*] Changed colors for all types of scopes
[*] Fixed a bug due to which the text of notes was not displayed
[*] The FP-45 pistol has a reduced shot radius
[*] Added disabling of game sounds during pause
[*] Increased maximum mouse sensitivity in the settings menu
[/list]

We would also like to tell you about the plans for the next updates:
[list]
[*] Soon we will slightly modify the task system, namely task markers. This problem seriously interferes with the game in the mission "Anthropoid". New markers will be associated with a specific task.
[*] At the moment the game has an outdated pause menu. It requires major changes and improvements that will be made in the next updates.
[*] We are gradually working on new missions and in the near future these are: two missions in Normandy - a landing operation and a tank breakthrough, Stalingrad and operation "Torch".
[img]https://sun9-45.userapi.com/9RwtH8xEyU6sczdiEofYSiKoB-VooX8505mcmQ/yX_1O1Z5-qU.jpg[/img]
[img]https://sun9-60.userapi.com/-iLP00_TpiIbsvA5aE2l8x31XWcdjs0QbBuZ8Q/MJwF_fEYKpc.jpg[/img]
[img]https://sun9-14.userapi.com/SuR61C5XdeTCoXGY3UWIpsbGO0ViN6HWPfpk6w/tY2fZDKoWIk.jpg[/img]
[*] The current inventory in the game has a number of significant problems (for example, crashes), and the whole system is quite cumbersome. We plan to implement a simpler and more stable version of the inventory, but it will take a long time, so there is no need to wait for a new system in the near future.
[/list]
